description: Given a Dagster job/asset that refreshes a Power BI dataset or dataflow (via dagster-powerbi or a custom resource), convert it to an Orchestra pipeline YAML task with the correct integration_job (POWER_BI_REFRESH_DATASET vs. POWER_BI_REFRESH_DATAFLOW), correctly-named parameters, and credentials represented via a connection: field rather than inline.

evals.expected_output: Orchestra YAML with integration: POWER_BI, integration_job: POWER_BI_REFRESH_DATAFLOW, parameters.dataflow_id and parameters.workspace_id (not dataset_id or group_id), connection: field for the Azure service principal (not raw tenant_id/client_secret in YAML).

assertions.text: Every task uses the POWER_BI integration
integration_job only ever takes a valid Power BI value
parameters use dataflow_id, not dataset_id (dataflow, not dataset, refresh)
No literal tenant_id/client_id/client_secret values are written into the YAML — the Azure service principal is represented via a connection: field
parameters use workspace_id (not an invented key like group_id) for the workspace
No parameter keys are invented beyond dataflow_id, workspace_id, refresh_type, apply_refresh_policy
